extraction.method: Read NUL-terminated model IDs within each ParticipantReplaySnapshot record; count IDs without storing driver names.

relationship_to_render_capture.interpretation: The cache supplies a game-owned participant roster temporally adjacent to the bounded D3D9 capture. It has no capture-frame or draw identifier, so it does not map a participant model to any target shader draw.

shader_cache.result: No separate game-owned compiled shader cache file was found in those searched locations; replaycache.rep is a game-setup/replay participant snapshot.
shader_cache.searched_locations: SHIFT installation tree and the PortProton user Documents/NFS SHIFT profile for shader/cache names and common compiled shader extensions
